content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the EPFO Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) Online Form 2026 under Special Advt. No. 52/2026.

Short Details of Notification

  • Application Begin : 22/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online : 11/09/2026 upto 06 PM Only.
  • Pay Exam Fee Last Date : 11/09/2026
  • UPSC APFC Exam Date : 20/12/2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : ₹25/-
  • SC / ST / PH : ₹0/-
  • Mode : Online / Offline Fee Mode Only

Read the official notification before applying and verify the final eligibility, vacancy, and details on the authorized UPSC portal.
